# Wave

> Wave is a free, all-in-one financial management platform for small businesses and freelancers offering invoicing, accounting, payments, payroll, and professional bookkeeping services.

Wave provides integrated money management tools designed specifically for small business owners and self-employed professionals. The platform combines invoicing, accounting, receipt scanning, payment processing, and payroll capabilities with optional professional advisory services.

## Key Topics

- Invoicing Software
- Small Business Accounting
- Payment Processing
- Payroll Software
- Receipt Scanning
- Tax Preparation
- Bookkeeping
- Cash Flow Management
- Mobile Apps (iOS/Android)
- Wave Pro Plan
- Wave Advisors
- Tax Season
- Financial Statements
- Self-Employed Taxes
- Online Payments

## Core Products & Features

- [Wave: Small Business Software - Wave Financial](https://www.waveapps.com): Wave Financial's suite of money management tools for invoicing, payments, and accounting
- [Best Invoice Software for Small Businesses - Wave Financial](https://www.waveapps.com/invoicing): Wave invoicing software with payment processing and customer management
- [Small Business Accounting Software - Start for Free](https://www.waveapps.com/accounting): Wave accounting and bookkeeping software for small businesses and freelancers
- [Accept Invoice Payments Online - Wave Financial](https://www.waveapps.com/payments): Wave online payment processing for invoices via credit card and Apple Pay
- [Payroll Software for Small Businesses - Wave Financial](https://www.waveapps.com/payroll): Wave payroll software with direct deposit and tax forms for small businesses
- [Estimates Software for Small Businesses](https://www.waveapps.com/estimates-software): Wave estimate software for creating and converting estimates to invoices

## Mobile & Premium Services

- [Best Invoicing App For Small Businesses - Wave Financial](https://www.waveapps.com/wave-app): Wave invoicing app for iOS and Android with integrated accounting features
- [Scan Receipts with Wave - iOS & Android](https://www.waveapps.com/receipts): Wave's mobile receipt scanning and expense tracking feature for iOS and Android
- [Wave Pro Plan - Wave Financial](https://www.waveapps.com/pro): Wave Pro Plan with automated bookkeeping, receipt scanning, and recurring invoices
- [Personalized Bookkeeping Help with Wave Advisors - Wave Financial](https://www.waveapps.com/wave-advisors): Wave Advisors professional bookkeeping and coaching services for small businesses
